description: Every capability is exposed through proto + Connect-RPC. The CLI (`go-code-graph extract`, `go-code-graph rewrite plan`, `go-code-graph rewrite apply`) is a translation layer over Connect clients; the UI is the same. No REST/JSON workarounds.

requirements.description: Every capability of go-code-graph (Extract, Rewrite plan, Rewrite apply) must be exposed as a Connect-RPC service defined in proto. The CLI commands (go-code-graph extract, go-code-graph rewrite plan, go-code-graph rewrite apply) must be implemented as thin translation layers that construct Connect client requests and format responses for human consumption. The UI must similarly consume the same Connect-RPC endpoints. No REST/JSON workarounds, HTTP handler shortcuts, or capability-only-in-CLI/UI implementations are permitted. All three surfaces (proto+RPC, CLI, UI) must have full capability parity.
requirements.title: Connect-RPC Primary Interface with CLI and UI as Translation Layers

validation.notes: Test that CLI extract command constructs a valid ExtractRequest proto and calls the Connect client (mock the client)
Test that CLI rewrite plan command constructs a valid RewriteRequest without plan_id and calls the Connect client
Test that CLI rewrite apply command constructs a valid RewriteRequest with plan_id and apply flag and calls the Connect client
Test that CLI output formatting handles all response fields (nodes, edges, warnings, plan_id)
Verify no direct HTTP handler or REST endpoint is registered outside Connect-RPC routing
CLI go-code-graph extract against a live server returns the same graph as a direct Connect-RPC call with identical request
CLI go-code-graph rewrite plan returns the same plan_id and operation log as a direct Connect-RPC call
UI Extract invocation produces the same graph as CLI and direct Connect-RPC call for the same scenario_path
Connect-RPC service descriptor lists exactly the methods: Extract, RewritePlan, RewriteApply
Any new capability added to the proto service is automatically available to CLI and UI without separate implementation
No feature exists in CLI or UI that is not expressed in the proto service definition
Connect-RPC is the single integration point for all automated consumers (cartographer, etc.)

title: Connect-RPC + CLI + UI Parity
